lines.en: I shift in the dark.
I move only at the edge of your sight.
My steps keep pace with my shadow.
I slip along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我从柱子后面挪到下一根。
lines.en: I move from pillar to pillar.
I never walk in the light.
My shadow is always a step ahead.
I slide along the wall without dropping dust.
The floor dampens where I go.

lines.zh: 我在你背后的那面墙后。
lines.en: I am behind the wall at your back.
You take three steps; I take one.
When you look, I am not there.
I watch from the dark.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在这里几乎看不见。
lines.en: My eyes barely show here.
I wait for you to be alone.
The shadow here is enough.
I stay still, and you dare not move.
I counted your steps.
I need nothing at all.
I am on the ceiling too.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在空房间里打转。
lines.en: Your breath circles the empty room.
The light cannot reach this corner.

lines.zh: 我在这个位置站了很久。
lines.en: I have stood in this spot a long while.
When you turn, I am here.

lines.zh: 这间屋子只有你一个在喘。
lines.en: You're the only one breathing in this room.
Every lamp in the hall is dead.
I am at this spot.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，可我知道你怕。
lines.en: You cannot see me, but I know your fear.
You are hunting that door.

lines.zh: 这个房间比你以为的小。
lines.en: This room is smaller than you think.
I am on your left.
No. The other side.

lines.zh: 你说什么我听得很清楚。
lines.en: I hear every word you say.
You do not need the torch.
Blow it out.
I am behind this wall.

lines.zh: 我数着你踩过几块地板。
lines.en: I count how many floorboards you cross.

lines.zh: 从你进门起，我就在这面墙后。
lines.en: I've been behind this wall since you entered.
All the time is mine.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙角，等你走进来。
lines.en: I hug the corner, waiting for you.
Is your back cold?
Very little separates us now.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，也不是善意。
lines.en: I mean neither harm nor kindness.
Why look over there?
Do not glance this way.

lines.zh: 我就在你转过去的方向。
lines.en: I am exactly where you will turn.
I retreat into the dark.

lines.zh: 刀锋过去，墙上多一道白痕。
lines.en: The blade passes; a white line appears on the wall.

lines.zh: 我连退都没退，只是淡了一层。
lines.en: I don't even retreat; I just fade a shade.
That does not matter.
My shape trembles once.

lines.zh: 被你劈开的影子重新合上。
lines.en: The shadow you split closes again.
Did you hear me laugh?
I am still beyond the wall.
You waste your effort.
That hand of yours. Noted.
I have no use for any of it.
Set it on the floor.

lines.zh: 光会让你安心，也让我清楚。
lines.en: Light comforts you. It shows me more.

lines.zh: 你的干粮在桌上，我绕开。
lines.en: Your rations sit on the table; I go around.

lines.zh: 火光只会让我看清你的位置。
lines.en: Firelight only shows me where you are.
You're stalling; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我在暗处看。
lines.en: You lift the food; I watch from the dark.

lines.zh: 火把照不到我这个角落。
lines.en: Your torch doesn't reach this corner.
Nowhere near enough.
What else do you have?
You touched emptiness.
I am the same color as the wall.
You stepped away backwards.

lines.zh: 你碰到了空处，我和墙一个颜色。
lines.en: You touched nothing; I am the colour of the wall.
Your hand is cold now.
I weigh nothing at all.

lines.zh: 你穿过的是一团更冷的空气。
lines.en: What you passed through is colder air.

lines.zh: 暗处有呼吸，你听见了吗？
lines.en: Something breathes in the dark. Hear it?
There is only you and me.
Touch it again.
I was born in the dark.
That is not why I came.
The dark isn't meant for two.
The head in the dark tilted.
I am waiting for something else.
I have no such thing.
That topic makes me shrink into the dark.
There is no such thing.
That should not be asked.
The door is behind you; I haven't blocked it.

lines.zh: 我把它挪了半格，你没看见。
lines.en: I shifted it half a block; you didn't see.
It is mine now.

lines.zh: 我不需要它，可我要拿走。
lines.en: I do not need it, and I will take it.
It cannot be seen in the dark.
You will not find it again.
I leave it where it is.
Is this a lure?
Clever enough.
It is stowed.
Keep looking.
You are on your own now.
Only the two of us here.
I need not come out.
The fire in your hand is dying.
I have waited a long time.

lines.zh: 你后颈的汗毛先知道了。
lines.en: The hairs on your nape know first.
You need not search.
I am in the shadow.

lines.zh: 灯灭的那格，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: In the block where the lamp died, I opened my eyes.
I hid my breathing in the wall's cracks.
This room will close.
I have plenty of patience.
Only you.
At this very moment.
I am coming out.
Stop. Do not move.

lines.zh: 我一直在你看不见的角度。
lines.en: I've stayed at the angle you can't see.
You turn; I am over here.

lines.zh: 你数不清这里有几个影子。
lines.en: You cannot count the shadows here.
I am two steps from you.
The wall behind you is creaking.
I need not come close.
That lamp is dead.

lines.zh: 你数影子，永远少数一个。
lines.en: Count the shadows; you'll always be one short.
Fleeing changes nothing for me.
Did you hear steps?
That was not me at all.
I am not only one shape.
Your breathing guides me.
There is no way out of here.
Your shadow is growing.
Wait a short while.
Only one wall stands between us.
Listen for a moment.
I have moved.
You turned.
I reach from behind you.

lines.zh: 我的手握住了你的喉咙。
lines.en: My hand closes on your throat.
Not a single sound.
All you see is black.
You are dragged into the shadow.
I let go.
Still standing. Good.
There is not enough light here.
Your blade finds nothing.

lines.zh: 我的手从天花板垂下来。
lines.en: My hand lowers from the ceiling.
Your blood does not show in the dark.
You can hear me now, yes?
I step back into the wall.
Do not hurry to find me.
I am still in this spot.
This time I do not leave.
In the dark, I wait for you to blink first.
The light flickered, and I arrived.
I was in the corner the whole time.

lines.zh: 那声音从你左边来，其实在右边。
lines.en: The sound comes from your left, but I'm on the right.
What you heard was yourself.
You blinked when the light flickered.
I watch you from the dark.
You have not noticed me.
This room will do.
My red is in the dark.
Do not put out the light.
No — turn it off.
I am quite silent.
I hide in the corner of the frame.
You never looked back.
This spot will do.
Right at this spot.
Come nearer.
I am waiting for you.

lines.zh: 你擦亮火柴时，我在光圈外。
lines.en: When you strike a match, I'm outside the ring of light.

lines.zh: 火光照出我，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: Firelight shows me. I dislike it.
I fall without a shadow.
Under the water, I am still watching.

lines.zh: 白光把整间屋子照透了。
lines.en: The white light pierces the whole room.
It passes through me.
That light has found me.
My belly will never make a sound.
In the flash I see all of you.
This was always dark.
